name: Seoul POPCON
blurb: Seoul's pop-culture convention at COEX, produced with Brazil's CCXP and spanning games, comics, webtoons, film, music and cosplay.
notes: The 2026 edition (Seoul POPCON 2026 by CCXP) already ran Aug 14-16, 2026 at COEX, confirmed by the homepage's own key-art banner text '14(Fri)-16(Sun) August, Coex' and matching WebSearch results — that is before today's window start (2026-10-05), so it is not listed. No 2027 dates are announced yet: the show-info page is still titled '2026 Show Information' and the newest Notice post is an 8 Apr 2026 item about 2026 booth applications, with nothing posted since the August show. Organizer is Exporum Inc. (CEO Danny Hyundae Shin, per site footer); 'by CCXP' in the branding reflects a partnership with Brazil's CCXP, not a separate organizer.
